entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Last one... "Diamond mine."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...No good.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How many'd we miss?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps he truly does have a barrier up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's not something to be excited about!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We know all the way up to "Diet[n]Building" too...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...So you enter keywords into the[n]Metaverse Navigator.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Boss, can you turn the TV on? Shido might[n]be on it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sure thing.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Goro Akechi...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Him and his stupid, composed face!

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: So, Akechi-san.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Is it true you withdrew yourself from the[n]media as part of your plan to capture[n]the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I truly apologize for causing such a stir.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Honestly, it required a lot of courage[n]to openly oppose them when their[n]popularity was at its peak.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I mean, people often lashed out at me[n]online and whatnot.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Then, was it also your plan when you said[n]they weren't at fault after their popularity[n]declined?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That was to catch them off guard. I could[n]say I applied my profiling knowledge.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Once they lost public support, someone[n]they thought was their greatest enemy[n]lent a hand...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's the same strategy used in romance,[n]wouldn't you agree?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Why is he being treated as an "ace[n]detective of justice"!?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's not just on TV or online. Newspapers,[n]magazines... I see his face everywhere.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: On the other hand, no one's hoping for[n]our comeback on the Phan-Site, like at all!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are "evil." Shido[n]and Akechi are "just"... It should be the[n]other way around.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They're manipulating information using[n]the media!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Leaving Akechi aside—we'll get back at[n]him later—our main issue is Shido.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Were there any instances before when[n]you didn't know the Palace keywords?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, there was the time with Futaba.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We didn't know anything about her, so[n]all we could do was make conjectures.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then, why don't we just go directly and[n]see Shido?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's impossible. He's surrounded by[n]bodyguards and followers all the time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There's no way high school students can[n]get an appointment with him either.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, we do have an adult with us...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: No, that's still impossible. Besides, that's[n]too dangerous a method.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well this is a problem...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's with the ruckus outside?

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: To everyone gathered before Yongen-Jaya[n]Station!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Isn't that an election-campaign car?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh right! The candidates are currently[n]campaigning!
That voice...

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: I apologize for the commotion! I am[n]Masayoshi Shido!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, did he just say, "Shido"!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, he did!
It sounds like the same voice[n]I heard back then...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, talk about bein' lucky! We can go[n]check him out without an appointment[n]now!
